name: push: a worked example on other numbers that comes out to his own answer is a leak, in digits or in words; it is swapped for the rung's safe line

lines.line: Try a fresh one: in a minus 9 equals 2. Getting rid of the minus 9 means adding 9 to each side. So a equals 2 plus 9, which is 11.
So a comes out to eleven.
Say y minus 4 equals 10: add 4 to both sides, so y equals 14.
Look at the six on your line: which side did it start on?
Your answer should be twenty one.
Keep your eye on the right-hand side, where the six ended up after it crossed over.
